title: Longevypedia article document
description: Long-form editorial text that is not itself a study, a claim or an entity page: overviews, explainers, field notes. Everything factual in it must trace back to cited sources.

kind.description: Editorial format. `overview` and `explainer` are encyclopedic; `essay` and `interview` are opinionated and must say so.

series.description: Series name, when the text belongs to one.
